The '''Paradise system''', also known by its designation '''J21-Z65''', consisted of a group of [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] a small [[Star/Legends|star]] along the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], located in [[Airam sector/Legends|Airam sector]]. Sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the [[Ugor/Legends|Ugors]] introduced a remnant of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]], which included its [[Gravity well projector/Legends|gravity well projector]]. This was used to hold an orbiting ring of garbage. The Paradise system was the home of the Ugors, who regarded it as sacred.
